turns.content: What pluripotency state is targeted when mouse embryonic stem cells are meant to resemble the pre-implantation inner cell mass?
Which defined, serum-free culture regimen is commonly used to maintain cells in that state while limiting heterogeneous differentiation, and why does it fit the goal?
Name the three principal components of this defined serum-free regimen and state their functional roles.
Contrast the selected regimen with the relevant conventional alternative. Which feature supports the stated target state?
Give the complete medium recipe for maintaining the target state.
Explain how each component supports the target pluripotent state rather than merely providing generic growth support.
State the complete culture condition and the pluripotent state it is intended to maintain.
